turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Singh?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Singh. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am Anjali from the logistics office. I am calling about your furniture shipment arriving in Pune today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, the sofa set. Is it coming today? I was told next week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It arrived at our warehouse earlier than expected, sir. Our driver is currently near Kothrud.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Kothrud is quite far from my house, will he reach by evening?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he should be there by 5 PM. I just wanted to confirm if your address on the invoice is still correct.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, let me check my glasses. Yes, the address is the same as always.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect. Just a reminder that the balance amount is twenty five thousand rupees to be paid to the driver.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twenty five thousand, yes. I have the cheque ready for him.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is fine, sir. Please just keep your phone reachable so the driver can call you when he reaches your gate.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay beta, I will be waiting. Thank you for informing me.
